_about: The cut list for the call scene: which stretches of the raw call recording (recordings/call.m4a) make the 40s the video uses. Each cut is { in, out } in seconds of the RAW recording, played in order. Cut at lender turns and dead air (the AI disclosure's tail, the read-back pauses, the wait while Yoshua approves, the reference spelled out slowly). The cuts must add up to the call scene's length in timeline.json (40s); align-call.mjs warns if they don't. PLACEHOLDER: these numbers are a guess for a ~90s call and must be redone by ear against the real take (listen in QuickTime or Audacity, note in/out times). Then run: node scripts/video/align-call.mjs
